label: Patient MRN
description: Medical Record Number uniquely identifying the patient in the HIS. Format: MRN-XXXXXX (e.g., MRN-042817).

label: Insurance Provider
description: Name of the patient's health insurance provider from the list of empanelled insurers.

label: Insurance Policy Number
description: Patient's insurance policy number. Format: POL-XX-XXXXXXXX (e.g., POL-SH-20241234).

label: Diagnosis Code (ICD-10)
description: ICD-10 diagnosis code as specified by the treating physician (e.g., M54.5 for low back pain, G43.9 for migraine).

label: Procedure Code (CPT)
description: CPT or hospital procedure code for the medical procedure being authorized or scheduled (e.g., T7220 for MRI Lumbar Spine without contrast).

label: Bed Type
description: Category of bed requested for the patient, aligned with clinical need and insurance/payment category.

label: Discharge Date
description: Date the patient is discharged from the hospital. Must be on or after the admission date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

label: Billing Amount (USD)
description: Total billing amount in USD relevant to the correction, waiver, or insurance claim being processed.

label: Referring Physician ID
description: Hospital-assigned ID of the referring physician. Format: DOC-XXXX (e.g., DOC-0214).

label: Patient Full Name
description: Full legal name of the patient as recorded in the HIS registration record.

label: Scheduled Date
description: Date on which the investigation, procedure, or appointment is scheduled. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

label: TPA Portal Status
description: Current status of the pre-authorization or claim request as shown on the TPA portal.

label: Department Code
description: Hospital department code in the HIS. Format: DEPT-XXX (e.g., DEPT-014 for Radiology).

label: Staff Employee ID
description: Hospital-assigned employee ID of the staff member. Format: EMP-XXXXX (e.g., EMP-00412).

label: Ward / Room Number
description: Ward name or room number where the patient is located or equipment is installed (e.g., Ward 3B, Room ICU-07).

label: Equipment Asset ID
description: Biomedical asset identifier from the hospital's equipment register. Format: EQ-XXXXX (e.g., EQ-00312 for Ventilator Unit 12).

label: Incident Severity
description: Severity classification of the reported incident or near-miss per Quality & Accreditation standards. Sentinel = unexpected patient death or serious harm.

label: Waiver Percentage (%)
description: Percentage of the total bill being requested as a financial waiver. Must be between 0 and 100. Requests above 25% require escalated approval.

label: Reason for Request
description: Free-text justification for the operational request, correction, or escalation. Must be specific and reference relevant details.

label: Approver Employee ID
description: Employee ID of the supervisor or manager approving the request. Required for billing corrections, waiver requests, and elevated access provisioning.

label: Incident Type
description: Category of the reported incident or near-miss as defined in the hospital's Incident Classification Framework.

label: Specimen Type
description: Type of biological specimen being submitted for laboratory analysis.

label: Ward Name
description: Name of the hospital ward (e.g., ICU Ward A, General Ward 3B, Emergency Department).

label: Consent Type
description: Category of informed consent being obtained from the patient or authorized representative.

label: Procurement Amount (USD)
description: Total value in USD of the procurement request or purchase order being submitted.
